acceptance_criteria.then: the footer contains a <span> with the current year (e.g. "2026")
the footer contains the text "Pixie Sandbox" adjacent to the copyright year (the visible line reads "© {year} Pixie Sandbox")
the existing GitHub link, BackToTop component, and last-updated paragraph behave exactly as they did before

assumptions.assumption: The copyright text should sit on the same line as the existing "© {year}" inside the existing span, followed by the dot separator and GitHub link.
No separate component is needed — the change is a one-line text addition inside the existing Footer component.

clarified_description: The site footer (components/Footer.tsx) currently renders a copyright line as "© {year}" followed by a dot and a GitHub link. This change adds the text "Pixie Sandbox" after the year so the full line reads "© {year} Pixie Sandbox". The year is computed client-side via `new Date().getFullYear()` which already exists in the component.

constraints.detail: No additional runtime cost — the year is already computed via `new Date().getFullYear()` on every render.
Must match the existing muted text styling (`text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400`) used by the copyright span.

must: WHEN the Footer component renders the system shall display the text "© {current year} Pixie Sandbox" where {current year} is the result of `new Date().getFullYear()`.
The system shall render the copyright text inside a <span> element.
The system shall not alter the existing GitHub link, BackToTop component, or last-updated paragraph.
The system shall preserve the existing CSS classes on the footer container and its children.

non_functional.target: copyright text is perceivable and does not interfere with existing accessible names

outcome: Visitors see "© {current year} Pixie Sandbox" in the site footer.
rationale: The feature request is minimal: append 'Pixie Sandbox' to the existing copyright line. The Footer component already computes the year client-side and renders it in a span with the correct styling. The change is a single insertion point inside that span. No new components, contracts, or data changes are needed. Existing tests for the year and the GitHub link will continue to pass; a new test verifies the full copyright string.

risks.mitigation: The existing code already uses client-side `new Date().getFullYear()` inside a React component, so this is an existing pattern — no new risk introduced.
risks.title: Year mismatch between server and client during SSR

metrics: No regressions in Footer.test.tsx tests (existing + new assertion)

sections: Text content must be readable and not hidden
Links must have an accessible name

swe_constraints: Append ' Pixie Sandbox' inside the existing © {year} so it reads © {year} Pixie Sandbox.
Do not modify the dot separator, the GitHub link, the BackToTop component, or the last-updated paragraph.
Match the existing span styling — no new className needed.
Add a test assertion in __tests__/Footer.test.tsx that verifies the full copyright string contains both the year and 'Pixie Sandbox'.

touches.reason: holds the copyright line that needs the 'Pixie Sandbox' text appended
existing test file that needs a new assertion for the full copyright line

wont: The system shall not change the copyright text format beyond appending "Pixie Sandbox" (no clickable brand link, no different wording).
The system shall not introduce server-side rendering of the year — the existing client-side `new Date().getFullYear()` call remains.
